The '''Fire Bat''' was a creature found on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by early [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Fire Bat appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' as one of the minor enemies the player character faces in the game's Hoth level.
